purpose: Quantify descriptive training-vs-new-match performance of the same frozen current model, not fit or tune anything.
games: All 36 original PFF training IDs in the unchanged source protocol; no selection by score
reference: Canonical original PFF event-state reference; no target-match GT
comparison: 36 in-sample training games, ten previously reused development games, six prospectively frozen new matches. Report each group separately; no pooling into a fake test set.
interpretation: A training/test gap measures optimism plus source/schedule difficulty differences. It does not alone identify overfitting causally; low gap does not prove absence of overfitting. No promotion or post-test selection.
execution: Two independent CPU workers, same deterministic inference. Check frozen source/weights before and after. Save every game aggregate, including failures.
